pattern.short_summary: Two or more views of the same underlying object are shown at once, each of them editable, and an edit in any one propagates to the others.
pattern.definition: Two or more views of the same underlying object are shown at once, each of them editable, and an edit in any one propagates to the others. Neither view is subordinate: the user may work in whichever is convenient and the system reconciles them. The conversion runs in both directions rather than compiling one representation into the other.
pattern.structural_signature: A shared model backs multiple concurrently displayed representations; each representation has write access to the model; a propagation step updates the sibling representations after any write. The loop is closed — starting in representation A, converting to B, and editing B returns a valid state in A.

dimension.category_description: How users inspect, modify, scope, revise, accept, program, or interrupt generated work at the artifact level.
dimension.classification_boundary: Centers user control during or after generation, including editable intermediate generators and representations.
